headline: GOLD HOLDS $4,035 OVERNIGHT NOV 11 — TESTS KEY SUPPORT AFTER $100 DROP ON CPI SHOCK
snippet: Gold settled at $4,035 per ounce in overnight trading on November 11, stabilizing after shedding roughly $100 per ounce on Monday following a hotter-than-expected US CPI print. Traders are watching the $3,886 level flagged by Standard Chartered as the next line of defence if December rate hike bets firm further.

headline: PMET DELIVERS ENHANCED CV5 LITHIUM-TANTALUM FS — CANADA'S LARGEST LITHIUM PEGMATITE ADDS NEW REVENUE STREAM
snippet: PMET Resources has released its long-awaited enhanced CV5 lithium-tantalum feasibility study for the Shaakichiuwaanaan project in Quebec, adding tantalum byproduct credits to the economics of Canada's largest lithium pegmatite deposit. The updated study builds on a 2025 lithium-only FS that showed an NPV8 of US$1.19 billion, and is expected to improve economics meaningfully with tantalum revenue from the same ore body.

headline: DOW, S&P 500 FALL NOV 10 AS GOLD AND OIL RETREAT — CPI ROUT SPREADS INTO EQUITIES
snippet: US equities slid on November 10 after a hotter-than-expected CPI reading locked in expectations for a December Fed rate hike, with the Dow Jones, Nasdaq, and S&P 500 all retreating alongside gold and crude oil. For mining investors the selloff signals a continued headwind: rising real yields compress gold's appeal while fears of slower growth weigh on base metals demand.

headline: GREENLIGHT METALS HITS 52.18M AT 1.12 G/T AU IN PHASE 2 — BEND GOLD-COPPER VMS, WISCONSIN GROWS
snippet: GreenLight Metals' Phase 2 drill program at the Bend VMS deposit in Taylor County, Wisconsin has returned 52.18 metres at 1.12 g/t gold and 1.28% copper equivalent from hole B26-009, confirming both copper-rich massive sulfide lenses and a broader gold-bearing footwall zone. Two diamond core rigs continue to drill with assays pending from B26-012, extending one of the few high-grade VMS targets in the continental US.

headline: MEDALLION METALS KICKS OFF 9,000M EXTENSION DRILL AT 1.46MOZ KUNDIP — DEEPER GOLD TARGETS IN FOCUS
snippet: Medallion Metals has launched a 9,000-metre resource-extension and exploration program at its 1.46-million-ounce Kundip Mining Centre in Western Australia, targeting extensions to existing deposits and new deeper gold-copper intersections. The November launch follows 2026 infill drilling that returned highlight intercepts of 3m at 17.8 g/t gold and 2m at 21.3 g/t gold, with the new program designed to grow the resource ahead of a development decision.

headline: ANAX METALS DRILLS 16.5M AT 2.68% ZINC, 32.9 G/T SILVER AT MONS CUPRI — 1.06% COPPER EQUIVALENT
snippet: Anax Metals (ASX:ANX) has reported drill results from the Mons Cupri VMS copper-zinc system in Western Australia, with hole 26ANXDD007 returning 16.52 metres grading 2.68% zinc, 1.21% lead and 32.9 g/t silver for 1.06% copper equivalent. The result extends the system along strike and adds to a growing body of drill data as the company advances toward a resource update.

headline: ACG METALS SNAPS UP $220M ARCTIC COPPER MINE — NUSSIR DEAL ADDS NORWEGIAN PRODUCTION NEAR HAMMERFEST
snippet: London-listed ACG Metals agreed on November 3 to acquire Blue Moon Norway from Canadian owner Blue Moon Metals for USD $220 million in shares, gaining a 94.52% stake in Nussir, an advanced copper development project near Hammerfest in northern Norway. The all-share deal, expected to close by November 30, adds a near-production Arctic copper asset at a time when European supply diversification has become a strategic priority.

headline: ENERGY FUELS Q3 2026: URANIUM PIPELINE ADVANCES + FIRST NdFeB ALLOY REVENUE FROM KOREAN RARE EARTH PLANT
snippet: Energy Fuels reported Q3 2026 results showing continued uranium production ramp-up alongside approximately $400,000 in revenue from finished neodymium-iron-boron alloys shipped from its Korean Metals Plant, marking the first commercial rare earth alloy output from a US-linked uranium producer. The dual uranium-and-rare-earth revenue model positions Energy Fuels at a strategic crossroads of two critical minerals supply chains ahead of the DFARS 0.1% compliance deadline.

headline: LME COPPER AT $14,152/T PIVOTS THROUGH NOVEMBER — SHFE STOCKS NEAR 3-YEAR LOWS TIGHTEN SUPPLY PICTURE
snippet: LME copper traded at approximately $14,152 per tonne through early November, caught between competing forces: Chinese copper smelters squeezed by collapsing sulphuric acid byproduct prices and a supply-side tightening visible in SHFE warehouse stocks near three-year lows. Goldman Sachs trimmed its year-end 2026 copper price forecast to $13,735/t, flagging potential refined-copper tariff risk as a ceiling on prices through year-end.

headline: 5 CANADIAN GOLD MINERS TO WATCH IN NOVEMBER 2026 — CONTRARIAN PICKS AFTER THE SECTOR'S WORST MONTH
snippet: Canadian Mining Report identifies five junior and mid-tier gold miners worth watching in November 2026 after the sector's worst month in over a year, with names trading at deep discounts to intrinsic value at current gold prices near $4,035. The analysis highlights all-in sustaining costs, net debt ratios, and near-term catalyst calendars as the key metrics separating re-rating candidates from value traps in the current rate-hike environment.
